general.notes: XGSPON OLT Class N1; single-fiber bidirectional 9.953G downstream and 9.953G/2.488G upstream. Receiver sensitivity at 9.953G measured with PRBS 2^31-1 @ 9.95328 Gbps, BER = 10^-3; at 2.488G with PRBS 2^23-1 @ 2.48832 Gbps, BER = 10^-4. Transmitter dispersion penalty max 1 dB with transmit on 20 km SMF (note 2). Extinction ratio measured with PRBS 2^31-1 @ 9.95328 Gbps. LOS deassert rows use unit dB in table (labeled 'LOS Optical Dessert'). Ordering lists LG-SC5210-20CN1 (0°C~+70°C) and LG-SC5210-20IN1 (-40°C~+85°C Industrial); datasheet header part is LS-SC5210-20CN1. Pout @ TX-Disable asserted max -39 dBm. Spectral width (@-20 dB) max 1 nm on TX.
